name: Eristalinus aeneus
desc: Syrphid Fly (Eristalinus aeneus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Eristalinus aeneus (Scopoli, 1763), the common lagoon fly, is a fairly common species of syrphid fly observed throughout the United States and Europe.
